train-go-flag--url-r1.prompt:
Add a new flag type to urfave/cli: `cli.URLFlag`, which accepts an absolute URL (it must have a scheme and a host) and parses it into a `*url.URL`. Its value is read with a new accessor `cmd.URL(name string) *url.URL`. A value it cannot parse must make the command fail with an error. Examples of valid input: `https://example.com/x`, `http://localhost:8080`. Examples of invalid input: `example.com`, `not a url`, `://x`.

Include tests, list the new flag in the flags documentation, and update the generated API documentation, as the project does for new flag types.

the command to fail with an error message.

EOF
